explanation: The first shifting theorem gives L{e^{3t}f(t)}=F(s−3). Replacing s by s−3 shifts the graph of F(s) three units to the right, so option c is correct.

answers.correct_value: Shift the graph of $F(s)$ by $3$ units to the right.
answers.wrong_value: Shift the graph of $F(s)$ by $3$ units to the left.
